answer: Vouch bonds with cascading slashes: a new identity earns only after 3 existing members each lock a 40 POA bond behind it for 15 epochs. If an audit proves the newcomer fake, every voucher loses 50% of its bond, and 25% of that loss passes up to its own vouchers. A farm of 100 fake keys must tie up 4000 POA and risk its real accounts, so each extra identity adds a thread of liability, like a mirror that reflects the cost back. Bonds and slashes sit on-chain, so anyone can verify them. Honest members stay careful, and a quiet lagoon of vetted keys remains.
